press_references.value: Instructure Partners With Veriff to Give Institutions a New Defense Against Rising Credential Fraud

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure announced a partnership with Veriff to embed identity verification into Parchment Transcript Services, helping educational institutions screen transcript requests for credential fraud.

press_references.value: Instructure Advances Education Equity with AWS Support, Accelerating AI-Powered Learning Modernization and Workforce Pathways

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure and Amazon Web Services announced a collaboration supported by AWS's Education Equity Initiative. The effort will develop AI-powered LMS migration tools and expand Canvas Career to improve access to modern learning infrastructure, workforce education, and career pathways for underserved learners.

press_references.value: Instructure Names Copyleaks Exclusive AI and Text Matching Partner for Canvas, Expanding Academic Integrity Tools for K-12 and Higher Education

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure named Copyleaks as its exclusive top-tier AI and text-matching strategic sales partner for Canvas, enabling Instructure's global sales organization to directly sell Copyleaks' academic-integrity solutions to K-12 and higher education customers worldwide.

press_references.value: Instructure and Brandon Hall Group™ Partner to Advance Research on the Future of Work and Lifelong Learning

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure and Brandon Hall Group formed a new Eminence Partner collaboration to co-develop workforce learning research, including a Bellwether Research Report on the future of work and lifelong learning.

press_references.value: As AI and Screen Time Scrutiny Rise, Instructure's 2026 Evidence Report Finds Most Classroom Consumer Technology Lacks Verified Proof of Impact

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure and nonprofit InnovateEDU partnered to produce the 2026 Evidence Report analyzing the safety, effectiveness, and evidence base of 150 widely used classroom technologies.

press_references.value: Instructure and Orijin Partner to Expand Secure, Scalable Education Across United States Correctional Systems

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure and Orijin announced a new strategic partnership to use Canvas LMS to power Orijin’s education and workforce development programs across more than 300 U.S. correctional facilities in 20 states.

press_references.value: PennWest University, Google Partner to Expand AI Training

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure, maker of Canvas, and OpenAI announced a global partnership to embed OpenAI’s IgniteAI tools directly into Canvas for educators.

press_references.value: Instructure and OpenAI Announce Global Partnership to Embed AI Learning Experiences within Canvas

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure and OpenAI announced a global partnership to embed OpenAI's AI technology within the Canvas LMS, aiming to enhance educational experiences for teachers and students worldwide.

press_references.value: Instructure's Canvas LMS Enters South Korea to Strengthen Universities' Global Competitiveness

partnership_announcements.description: Instructure announced a strategic partnership with Linus to launch its Canvas LMS in South Korea, enabling local educational institutions to access Canvas' tools and services with localized support.

press_references.value: South Carolina Department of Education selects LearnPlatform by Instructure to provide local districts with actionable data on digital tools

partnership_announcements.description: The South Carolina Department of Education has partnered with Instructure to use LearnPlatform, providing local districts with actionable data on digital tools to improve student outcomes.

product_launches.description: Instructure introduced a new three-tier Canvas offering—Canvas Core, Canvas Plus, and Canvas Next—providing progressively advanced AI-supported and engagement capabilities under a simplified commercial structure.

press_references.value: Instructure Partners With Veriff to Give Institutions a New Defense Against Rising Credential Fraud

product_launches.description: Instructure is preparing Identity Verification for Parchment Transcript Services, enabling institutions to verify learners before fulfilling transcript requests. The service is planned for general availability in the United States in November 2026.

press_references.value: Instructure Announces Project Athena, an AI Study Coach Designed to Deliver In-Context Learning through Canvas

product_launches.description: Instructure announced Project Athena, an upcoming AI study coach integrated with Canvas that will generate personalized quizzes, study guides and coaching prompts using each student's course context and mastery model, initially piloted with institutions such as Hinds Community College.

press_references.value: Instructure Advances Skills-First Workforce Learning With Broad Availability of Canvas Career

product_launches.description: Instructure announced the broader availability of Canvas Career, an AI-powered, skills-first learning platform for adult and workforce-focused education, expanding access beyond initial early adopters.

press_references.value: Instructure Delivers on Safe, Simple AI Promise with IgniteAI and Major Ecosystem Updates

product_launches.description: Instructure launched IgniteAI, a suite of AI capabilities in Canvas LMS, including features like Discussion Insights, Rubric Generator, Translations, and the IgniteAI Agent to automate instructional workflows.

press_references.value: How Is UW-Madison Navigating AI Additions to Software Tools?

product_launches.description: Instructure, the parent company of Canvas, launched IgniteAI, a suite of AI tools integrated into Canvas to assist educators with grading, quiz creation, and assignment feedback, in partnership with OpenAI.

press_references.value: New LearnPlatform by Instructure Report Shows K-12 Districts Are More Selective About Edtech Tools as They Face Budget Crisis

product_launches.description: Instructure has launched Canvas Apps, a centralized hub within its Canvas LMS for discovering, installing, and managing LTI apps, aimed at simplifying edtech tool integration for K-12 schools and districts.

product_launches.description: A fact sheet providing an overview of data privacy practices and human involvement in AI tools.

about_short_description.short_description: Instructure is an education technology company developing a learning management system for K-12 and higher education.

product.name: Canvas
product.description: A learning management system for delivering, managing, and assessing courses across K–12, higher education, professional learning, and business education.

product.name: Mastery
product.description: An assessment and instructional insight platform that supports standards-aligned assessment, performance analysis, and data-informed teaching.

product.name: Parchment
product.description: A digital credentials and academic records platform for issuing, managing, sharing, and verifying education records and credentials.

product.name: LearnPlatform
product.description: An education technology management platform for organizing, evaluating, and administering digital tools used by educational organizations.

product.name: Impact
product.description: A digital adoption and engagement platform that helps organizations support users, communicate product guidance, and measure engagement with educational technology.

product.name: Intelligent Insights
product.description: An analytics and reporting offering that provides education stakeholders with information about learning activity, engagement, and outcomes.
